Agent Name: Boggle_Board_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The DFS logic compares the path built from the board (uppercase letters) directly against the words_alpha dictionary and its prefixes (which are all lowercase). This case mismatch causes the prefix check and word membership tests to fail immediately, pruning all searches and yielding an empty result. The error originates when implementing the DFS and validation without normalizing case.
